S.FORM: alang Kmuyaw ga niya mki sku Girang Keng atu Nango go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 101 buwan, 309 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 95% kyan ku 293 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 5% kyan ku 16 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 86%, Amis 3%, Truku 3%, Rukay 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 2%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkyahu' na Kmuyaw hya' ga Kb'bu. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ kmujaw ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ɣiraŋ keŋ atu naŋo ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** ami[s|ɕ] * truku * rukaj * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkjaħuʔ na kmujaw ħjaʔ ɣa kβʔβu reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
